# Optimal Partitioning with R

```{r OP_R}
n <- 100
gap <- 0.5
x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                      parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                      sdNoise = 1,
                      type = "gauss")
best_beta <- 2 * log(length(x))

# OP Algorithm
OP_R <- optimal_partitioning(x, best_beta)
plot(OP_R$costQ)

# Visualization
cpts <- OP_R$changepoints
plot(x, type = "o", main = "Optimal Partitioning using R",
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(x[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}
```

# Optimal Partitioning with Rcpp

```{r OP_CPP}
n <- 100
gap <- 0.5
x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                      parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                      sdNoise = 1,
                      type = "gauss")
best_beta <- 2 * log(length(x))

# OP Algorithm
OP_CPP <- rcpp_optimal_partitioning(x, best_beta)
OP_CPP$costQ

# Visualization
cpts <- OP_CPP$changepoints
plot(x, type = "o", main = "Optimal Partitioning using Rcpp",
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(x[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}
```

# Time execution between OP (R) and OP (Rcpp)

```{r Time_Exec_OP}
start <- 100
end <- 300
pas <- 50
n_vals <- seq(from = start, to = end, by = pas)
gap <- 0.5
temps_R <- numeric(length(n_vals))
temps_Rcpp <- numeric(length(n_vals))
length_data <- integer(length(n_vals))

for (i in 1:length(n_vals))
{
  n <- n_vals[i]
  x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                        parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                        sdNoise = 1,
                        type = "gauss")
  length_data[i] <- length(x)
  print(length(x))
  beta <- 2 * log(length(x))
  
  # Temps code R
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  optimal_partitioning(x, beta)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_R[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
  
  # Temps code C++
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  rcpp_optimal_partitioning(x, beta)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_Rcpp[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
}

plot(length_data, temps_R, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     xlab = "n : length of data", ylab = "Time (seconds)",
     main = "Time Exec Optimal Partitioning",
     ylim = c(0, max(max(temps_Rcpp),max(temps_R)) * 1.1))
lines(length_data, temps_Rcpp, type = "b", pch = 17, col = "blue")
legend("topleft",
     legend = c("R", "Rcpp"),
     col = c("red", "blue"),
     pch = c(16, 17),
     lty = c(NA, NA),
     lwd = c(NA, NA))
grid()
temps_R[length(temps_R)] / temps_Rcpp[length(temps_Rcpp)]
```

# Pruned Exact Linear Time with R

```{r PELT_R}
par(mfrow = c(2, 3))
BETA <- c(0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.23, 0.26, 0.30, 0.33, 0.37, 0.4)
for (i in 1:9)
{
n <- 100
gap <- 0.5
x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                      parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                      sdNoise = 0.2,
                      type = "gauss")
#best_beta <- 2 * sdDiff(x, "HALL")^2 * log(length(x)); best_beta
#best_beta <- 2 * log(length(x))
best_beta <- BETA[i]
# PELT Algorithm
PELT_R <- pelt(x, best_beta, 1)

# Visualization
cpts <- PELT_R$changepoints
plot(x, type = "o", main = paste("PELT using R, beta = ", round(best_beta, 2)),
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)

cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(x[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}
}
# (optionnel) Revenir à un affichage normal
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

# Time execution between PELT (R) and PELT (Rcpp)

```{r Time_Exec_PELT}
start <- 50
end <- 500
pas <- 50
n_vals <- seq(from = start, to = end, by = pas)
gap <- 0.5
temps_R <- numeric(length(n_vals))
temps_Rcpp <- numeric(length(n_vals))
length_data <- integer(length(n_vals))

for (i in 1:length(n_vals))
{
  n <- n_vals[i]
  x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20)*n,
                        parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0),
                        sdNoise = 0.2,
                        type = "gauss")
  length_data[i] <- length(x)
  print(length(x))
  beta <- 2 * log(length(x))
  
  # Temps code R
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  pelt(x, beta, 1)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_R[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
  
  # Temps code C++
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  rcpp_pelt(x, beta, 1)
  t1 <- Sys.time()
  temps_Rcpp[i] <- as.numeric(difftime(t1, t0, units = "secs"))
}

plot(length_data, temps_R, type = "b", pch = 16, col = "red",
     xlab = "n : length of data", ylab = "Time (s)",
     main = "Time Exec PELT", ylim = c(0, max(max(temps_Rcpp),max(temps_R)) * 1.1))
lines(length_data, temps_Rcpp, type = "b", pch = 17, col = "blue")
legend("topleft",
     legend = c("R", "Rcpp"),
     col = c("red", "blue"),
     pch = c(16, 17),
     lty = c(NA, NA),
     lwd = c(NA, NA))
grid()
temps_R[length(temps_R)] / temps_Rcpp[length(temps_Rcpp)]
```

# Smallest Valid Partitioning

```{r SVP}
n <- 10
gap <- 2
x <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(2, 5, 8, 13, 20) * n,
                      parameters = c(0, gap, 0, gap, 0),
                      sdNoise = 0.2,
                      type = "gauss")

gamma <- 2*log(length(x))*dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")

res <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(x, gamma = 100, test = valid_focus)

res$changepoints

# Visualization
cpts <- res$changepoints
plot(x, type = "o", main = "SVP in OP mode",
     ylab = "Values", xlab = "Time", col = "blue")
abline(v = cpts, col = "red", lwd = 2, lty = 2)
cpts2 <- c(0,cpts)
for (i in 1:(length(cpts2) - 1))
{
  segment_mean <- mean(x[(cpts2[i] + 1):cpts2[i + 1]])
  segments(x0 = cpts2[i] + 1, y0 = segment_mean,
           x1 = cpts2[i+1], y1 = segment_mean,
           col = "green", lwd = 2)
}
res$changepoints
```

```{r SIMU Valid_Range}
gap <- 2
n <- 500
data <- dataGenerator_1D(chpts = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n,
                         parameters = c(0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0,gap,0),
                         sdNoise = 1.5)

plot(data, type = 'b')
abline(v = c(0.1,0.3,0.4,0.45,0.55,0.7,0.75,0.95,1)*n, col = 2, lwd = 3)

pen <- 2*log(n)*dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")
penQ <- qnorm(p = 0.95)*dust::sdDiff(data, method = "HALL")

nb_simu <- 30
cp_OP_count <- 0
cp_Range_count <- 0
for (i in 1:nb_simu)
{
  print(i)
  resOP <- optimal_partitioning(data, beta = pen)
  resRange <- smallest_valid_partitioning_VR(data, gamma = pen, test = valid_Range)
  if (length(resOP$changepoints) >= length(resRange$changepoints))
  {
    cp_OP_count <- cp_OP_count + 1
  }
  else
  {
    cp_Range_count <- cp_Range_count + 1
  }
}
print(cp_OP_count)
print(cp_Range_count)
```
